pr_title: Fix doubleclick on tree item, restore input focus on previous windows.

issue_context.title: SceneTreeDock loses focus when changing Node's name & db-click not working
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
Current master branch (with DisplayServer update to separate windows)

**OS/device including version:**
Fedora
**Issue description:**
When double-click on Node to rename it - it doesn't popup TextBox with Node's name.
Only Enter key works - but then, after name is typed, SceneTreeDock is unfocused, 
so it's not possible to use arrow keys to go into next Node
**Steps to reproduce:**
Try to double click on Node.
Try to move Up or Down after you Enter-keyed renamed the Node

![scenetreedock](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1110337/77689358-d1e3b380-6fa1-11ea-9666-9e5b0a39ecd4.gif)

review_comments: Maybe add an empty line between the functions.

It seems both `_gui_show_tooltip` and `_gui_remove_focus` don't need to be bound, nothing seems to depend on them being bound (unless they're meant to be used from scripting, but then they shouldn't start with `_`).
